acceptance_predicates.description: The Makefile is optional developer tooling and no runtime, installed-user, or release path requires Make.
check-deps detects missing or mismatched Cargo, pinned Rust toolchain, target, and required host utilities without installing or downloading anything, and prints actionable remediation.
help, check-deps, build, install, clean, update, and test targets execute bounded documented workflows with safe defaults and overridable paths.
Build and test targets retain locked workspace, formatting, Clippy, documentation, and applicable quality-gate semantics rather than creating weaker substitutes.
Install, clean, and update refuse unsafe prefixes, dirty source trees, ambiguous toolchains, or destructive paths and remain bounded to the repository and configured staging root.

definition_of_done: Signed+DCO Makefile and supporting test/documentation changes are independently reviewed and merged on protected ASB main.
Positive and negative dependency, path, clean-tree, and target tests pass.
Exact current-main build/install/clean/update/test walkthrough and required hosted checks pass.
